data_fields.name: shield_weighting_score
data_fields.donor_constant: SHIELD_WEIGHTING 17 (score scale and per-turn travel penalty)

data_fields.name: fuzzy_easy
data_fields.donor_constant: 300 per mille (flip chance on a candidate that beats the best)

data_fields.name: trade_weighting_unhappy
data_fields.donor_constant: TRADE_WEIGHTING 18 x 2 per turn for unhappiness (not used in Frankendom)

best_idea: Score each enemy as expected trade minus travel time, discounted by delay and capped at a maximum reach, and let difficulty flip a choice only when it beats the best so far.
decision_why: Take the scoring shape and the fuzz roll on the running best with Frankendom units. Reject the victim-count multiplier as donor-shaped (one player per target in a Frankendom fight; the crowd cap is MAX_ATTACKERS = 3, an engine rule) and the city, ferry and occupy branches (no equivalent).
acceptance: A server test with one attacker and two players, one 3 turns away with lower defence and one 12 turns away, asserts the 3-turn player is picked and the 12-turn one is never picked; and over 1000 seeded picks with fuzzy 300 the pick differs from the zero-fuzz pick about 30% of the time, within 5 points.
